title: App Screens, Events, and Test Cases
prerequisites: Basic understanding of an app as a set of screens
Ability to type and save work in a browser
objectives: Define a specific user, problem, feature, and measurable success criterion.
Plan screens, interface elements, events, and stored values as one connected app flow.
Write repeatable test cases with starting conditions, actions, expected results, and pass rules.

requirements.account: No account required for module practice
requirements.storage: Progress remains in this browser and device
requirements.offline: Use the printed user-needs chart, screen cards, event map, and test-case table.

formalAssessment: Separate teacher directions and rubric are required.
